title: S&P 500 & Nasdaq post best quarter since 2020; Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surges 87.8% in Q2 — record quarterly advance
summary: The S&P 500 rose 14.8% and the Nasdaq gained 21.4% in Q2 2026, their best quarterly gains since the pandemic rally of Q2 2020. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index soared 87.8% in the quarter, its largest-ever quarterly advance, driven by the AI chip supercycle. Over 80% of S&P 500 companies beat earnings estimates in Q2, well above the long-run average of ~60%.
why: 美股创2020年以来最强季度，AI芯片板块领涨87.8%，港股科技股估值有望跟随修复；但季末大涨后隐含波动率可能回落，逢低布局sell put需关注7月初回调风险。

title: Tesla Q2 2026 delivery report due July 2: Wall Street consensus 406,024 vehicles; Goldman Sachs estimates 420,000
summary: Tesla is set to release Q2 2026 delivery figures on July 2. Wall Street consensus stands at 406,024 vehicles. Goldman Sachs analyst Mark Delaney estimates 420,000, citing solid recovery in Europe and China. Morgan Stanley raised its Q2 estimate to 413,000. For context, Q1 2026 left a ~50,000-unit inventory overhang. Tesla earnings follow on July 22.
why: 明日交付数据是TSLA近期最直接催化剂；若达420K+可触发多头追仓；持仓时可于7/22财报前布局covered call或观望sell put行权价位（TSLA当前约$370，YTD -17%）。

title: USTR proposes additional 12.5% Section 301 tariff on China in June; effective tariff rate on Chinese goods remains near 30%
summary: The US Trade Representative proposed a new 12.5% tariff on Chinese goods in June 2026 under a Section 301 forced-labor investigation. Combined with existing tariffs, the effective rate on many Chinese goods shipped to the US remains close to 30% — the highest of any trading partner. The tariffs amount to an average additional tax of $1,500 per US household in 2026.
why: 额外关税直接压制Temu/拼多多出海收益；港股出口相关标的估值受压；通胀预期上升使美联储降息时间后移，对全仓港股持仓产生多重负面：压制估值、抑制消费需求。

title: Tencent shares jumped ~10% after Bloomberg/CNBC reported WeChat AI agent 'Xiaowei' in consumer testing and enterprise 'Dayuan' rolling out on WeCom
summary: Tencent began testing 'Xiaowei', a native AI assistant within WeChat (consumer), allowing voice/text interaction with friends and mini-programs. The enterprise version 'Dayuan' — built on DeepSeek V4 — began rolling out on WeCom on June 23. Xiaowei uses Tencent's WeLM model, with DeepSeek for certain queries. Shares jumped most since late 2022 on the news. Public launch compliance process underway.
why: WeChat月活超13亿，AI原生接入若完成合规落地，将大幅提升变现潜力并催化估值重估；10%的股价反应显示市场已开始定价AI预期，腾讯(0700.HK)期权隐含波动率可能上升。
source: South China Morning Post / Bloomberg / CNBC

title: 阿里巴巴FY2026全年：云收入+34%至人民币1,581亿元，AI产品贡献云收入30%；总调整EBITA骤降56%，未来三年投入超550亿美元于AI基础设施
summary: 阿里云FY2026营收1,581亿元（同比+34%），调整后EBITA +35%至142.65亿元，AI相关产品贡献云收入约30%。然而集团整体调整后EBITA同比-56%至764亿元，自由现金流转为使用25.1亿美元，因大规模投入即时零售、用户获取及AI基础设施。公司宣布FY2026-FY2028间将投入逾550亿美元于AI与云数据中心。
why: 云+AI赛道高增长证明需求真实，但利润大幅下滑表明资本开支周期尚未进入收获期；自由现金流转负对分红/回购能力产生压制，sell put时需充分评估盈利能见度风险。

title: SK hynix ships HBM4E 12-layer samples (June 18): 16 Gbps/pin, 20% better power efficiency; UBS forecasts ~70% HBM4 market share for Nvidia Rubin
summary: SK hynix announced on June 18 that it has shipped HBM4E samples (12-layer) to major customers. Performance: maximum 16 Gbps per pin data speed and >20% power efficiency improvement vs HBM3E. Uses Advanced MR-MUF technology to achieve 48 GB in a 12-layer stack. UBS forecasts SK hynix will achieve ~70% HBM4 market share for Nvidia's next-generation Rubin platform. Nasdaq ADR listing (ticker SKHY) scheduled for around July 10.
why: HBM4E官方出货确认AI存储超级周期深化；CSOP南方两倍做多SK海力士ETF(7709.HK)直接受益；配合美光Q3+346%的营收数据，整体HBM供应商都有估值重估空间。

title: 携程集团Q1 2026净收入162亿元(同比+17%)；国际OTA平台预订量+65%，入境游预订量+90%
summary: 携程2026年Q1净收入162亿元（同比+17%），调整后EBITDA约48亿元（+14%）。分项：住宿预订收入65亿元(+17%)，交通票务61亿元(+12%)，旅游度假11亿元(+19%)，商旅管理6.9亿元(+20%)。国际业务爆发：境外OTA平台预订量同比+65%，入境旅游预订量激增+90%，来自亚太、欧洲、美国多个主要客源市场。
why: 出境和入境游双双超预期，提升携程全年盈利能见度；然而H1股价已跌逾30%（HSI最差成份股之一），sell put时行权价需与当前股价保持充足安全边距（30%+缓冲）。
source: 新浪财经 / 携程集团

title: FIFA World Cup 2026 delivers early economic boost: host city card spending +6.3% YoY; $9B GDP impact expected across North America
summary: Early July data shows card-based purchases in the 16 World Cup host cities up 6.3% year-over-year, driven by a 16.7% surge from non-local visitors. The tournament (June–July 2026, North America) is expected to generate ~USD 9 billion in GDP, drawing 6.5 million attendees including 2.6 million international visitors. Beneficiary sectors: hospitality, dining, sports betting, and media (Fox Corp holds English-language rights to all 104 matches).
why: 世界杯消费热潮对多项持仓形成催化：泡泡玛特FIFA联名Labubu出圈（品牌破圈）、美团Keeta在中东市场扩张获间接助力、麦当劳/好市多受益于美国消费提升；期权方向看，消费股implied vol或已提前定价。

title: EU orders Google to open Gemini AI and Android features to rivals under DMA; Alphabet simultaneously rationing Gemini access due to compute constraints
summary: The European Commission issued instructions to Alphabet requiring that competing AI developers can access core Google services linked to Gemini and Android under the Digital Markets Act (DMA). Simultaneously, Alphabet is limiting Gemini AI access as cloud capacity tightens, suggesting demand is outstripping supply. Alphabet's Gemini app has surpassed 750 million monthly active users. Alphabet also announced an $80B equity offering to fund AI compute infrastructure.
why: EU监管压力可能削弱谷歌在欧洲的AI生态护城河；Gemini算力限流反映AI基础设施扩张压力；$800亿融资规模创科技史上最大股权融资之一，短期摊薄效应值得关注（GOOGL期权波动率可能上升）。

title: SanDisk (SNDK) leads S&P 500 in 2026 with YTD gains reportedly exceeding 800%; NAND supply shortage confirmed to extend past 2027
summary: SanDisk (SNDK), spun off from Western Digital in February 2025, is the best-performing S&P 500 stock in 2026 with year-to-date gains of ~800–900% reported by multiple analyst sources. Catalysts: global NAND flash shortage, surging AI data center demand. The company says 2026 production capacity is fully sold out, with 2027 bookings described as strong. Q3 reported revenue of $5.95B with non-GAAP gross margins of 78.4%.
why: SNDK的爆涨幅度与美光Q3数据共同印证了NAND供应紧缺真实且持续，支撑美光/SanDisk期权策略：存储类股波动率高，sell covered call获取权利金具有吸引力；同时说明AI存储超级周期尚在进行中。

title: Palantir wins $300M USDA Blanket Purchase Agreement; 2026 revenue guidance $7.2B (+61% YoY); government AI contract awards expected to accelerate Q3
summary: Palantir secured a $300 million Blanket Purchase Agreement with the US Department of Agriculture (USDA) to support the National Farm Security Action Plan. The company provided 2026 revenue guidance of $7.2 billion, implying ~61% growth. In Q1 2026, AIP secured 204 contracts over $1 million, including 53 exceeding $10 million. Government contract awards typically accelerate in Q3 (July–September) as agencies complete budget allocation.
why: 政府合同加速落地提升PLTR营收能见度；但估值已极度拉伸（P/S >30x），持仓时需警惕任何预期差；高隐含波动率使sell put策略的权利金回报率较高，但需设置较宽安全垫。

title: （存疑）拼多多/Temu三重利空：欧盟5月罚款2亿欧元+美国日活骤降+营收增速降至个位数；PDD股价从峰值跌逾30%
summary: 欧盟于2026年5月对Temu开出2亿欧元罚款，指控其允许销售在欧盟境内非法产品。同年1月，都柏林总部遭突击检查，土耳其分支亦被突击。美国取消800美元以下包裹免税政策后，Temu被迫转向半托管模式，丧失低价优势，美国日活用户大幅下滑。PDD Holdings营收增速从2024年的59%降至个位数，股价自2025年11月峰值下跌逾30%。
why: Temu出海变现逻辑持续受损；若持有PDD多头仓位，需重新评估成长故事是否已破坏；拼多多目前估值已明显调整，sell put时行权价需结合营收减速风险充分下调。
